decision: One public label set for every course and audience: Support, Standard, Advanced. High-school teacher tools may prefix the track code (CP2 · Support, CP1 · Standard, Honors · Advanced). No student ever sees 'Remedial'. (Changed 2026-11-16 from 'Level 1 · Warm-Up / Level 2 · Core / Level 3 · Challenge' for students, per site audit Fix 7.)

tooltipsTeacher.cp2: More scaffolding: friendlier numbers, one step at a time, visual models.
tooltipsTeacher.honors: Extension: multi-step, reasoning and transfer problems.

studentLinkParam: Keep level=cp2|cp1|honors in URLs; render the student label from studentFacing.all.
